summary: In accordance with the provisions of Chapter 27, Council Procedures of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, a petition signed by 23 Members of Toronto City Council was submitted to the City Clerk on August 20, 2018 for a special meeting of City Council to be held for the following purpose: To receive a briefing from the appropriate City and/or Exhibition Place Officials on the status of negotiations between the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place and IATSE Local 58.
decided: City Council on August 21, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council confirm the confidential instructions issued to staff in closed session.

motions.desc: Majority required - CC46.1 - Tory - motion 1 - Adopt the Item as amended

text: In accordance with the provisions of Chapter 27, Council Procedures of the City of Toronto Municipal Code, a petition signed by 23 Members of Toronto City Council was submitted to the City Clerk on August 20, 2018 for a special meeting of City Council to be held for the following purpose: To receive a briefing from the appropriate City and/or Exhibition Place Officials on the status of negotiations between the Board of Governors of Exhibition Place and IATSE Local 58.
City Council on August 21, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council confirm the confidential instructions issued to staff in closed session.
